newsitem.title: UK: Sharply lower soymeal triggers active trade in UK.
newsitem.headline: Sharply lower soymeal triggers active trade in UK.

text.p: Falls of two to six stg a tonne in the prices of higher protein soymeal and as much as seven stg a tonne in Brazilian 48 pct material triggered active trading on the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday.
High protein soymeal ex-mill Liverpool was offered at 200 stg a tonne for Jun/Jul and Aug/Oct while Nov/Jan was a seller at 187 stg.
Brazilian 48's were offered at 193 stg for June and 184 stg for Jul/Oct.
Brokers reported good business in high pro on the east coast while 48's were selling well in the Liverpool and Avon areas.
Shippers were said to be the main sellers with compounders on the buy side.
"Unfortunately it's been one of those under-the-counter day's when every one knows the business is going on but can't find out what the prices are," said one broker.
"You have to look at the sellers and guess the traded levels, but it seems that the business has been done below the published prices," said another.
